name: fuzz-fleet-reminder-closes
description: Fuzz pbd299 (bot 3541163, ui:my-move-not-shown): End Turn posted the fleet-pool reminder ('you are violating fleet pool limits in Arcturus - Nomad', Remove Units + Dismiss = units.remove). The Nomad removed the extra flagship through its menu, but the reminder stayed open and waited on the player for good.
